newsitem.title: INDONESIA: PRESS DIGEST - Indonesian newspapers - June 2.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Indonesian newspapers - June 2.

text.p: The following are the leading stories in the Indonesian press on June 2. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

Chairman of the ruling Golkar party Harmoko has said the party's victory in the general elections was due to its hard work. He said Golkar planned to realise the people's aspiration in developing the country.

The National Commission of Human Rights said 77 people are still missing after the May 23 riot in Banjarmasin, capital of South Kalimantan province. The comission also confirmed the authorities' report that 123 people had died in the riot.

A mob set ablaze a number of government offices and houses in fresh violence on Madura island off East Java early on Sunday. Violence started last Thursday after local people protested that the ruling Golkar party had cheated in the elections.
